body:
N-34 DESIGN, CORRECTION to parts 1, 3 and 4b (the advisor's review, 15 Nov 2026; the design text in docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md is already corrected, read this instead of the sentences it replaces).
1. THE TAGGED COPY (part 3, per file, step 1). It said: copy to <album folder>/.name.part, tag the COPY, os.replace. That cannot work: tagging.write_tags picks its format from the file suffix (tagging.py:57-66) and its ffmpeg fallback writes <stem>.tagged<suffix> (:147-155), so a '.part' name fails both ways, and a file that cannot be tagged is never moved. CORRECT: copy into the server's WORK folder under the real suffix, tag it there, then place_file into the album folder (it makes the .part and the os.replace itself, placement.py:147-160), exactly as the keeper does (keeper.py:179-201).
2. THE 'PLAYING' GUARD (part 3 'OTHER', part 4b tests). It said: a playing song is skipped (playback_state.playing + ref). The app NEVER writes playback_state (docs/34 CF-41, Open (app)), so that guard guards nothing. CORRECT: the stream route (api.py:961-990) reads the ref's file at every request; slice 5 adds an in-memory 'last served' time per ref there (like quiet.InFlight; nothing in the database, nothing to a phone); the repair skips a ref served in the last 10 minutes and runs nothing in the first 10 minutes after a start. STILL UNGUARDED and stated: a range request that resumes after the swap is answered from the NEW file (different offsets), and a stream that starts mid-swap; the retry by the player is an expectation, not a proof. Test row in slice 5: 'a ref served in the last 10 minutes is skipped; nothing runs in the first 10 minutes after a start'.
3. 'REUSE, WITH ONE CHANGE' (part 1, point 2) is TWO changes: besides the priority (catalogue.py:586) Catalogue.album() waits in _gather for at most CALL_TIMEOUT_S = 2.5 s (catalogue.py:68,618) and gives the track list only what is left of it (:736): a background request would still run on a person's deadline and anything slower comes back as 'could not ask', which stops the pass. Slice 1 passes the priority AND the deadline through together (defaults stay interactive and 2.5 s, with a test that the routes still ask with both).
4. The item note in items.json says 'a single is its own release' as the DEFAULT of decision 3, not as settled.
